note: Per-cell (field, regime, lead-band) skip table for the NBM cascade. Curated from analysis/nbm_walkforward_validator.py per-regime SKIP proposals. Runtime skip check lives in weather_collector/processors/skip_table_nbm.py. Cell shape: [regime, lead_lo_inclusive, lead_hi_exclusive].

l3_nbm.dp.reasoning: L3_NBM subtracts pooled per-lead bias of +1.5°F at 0-5h. In these three regimes, l2_nbm is already close to obs (|err_l2_nbm| median ~1.9°F), so subtracting +1.5°F pushes dp AWAY from obs (l3_nbm MAE 4.3 vs l2_nbm MAE 1.9). Selector currently picks HRRR for dp 0-5h so no user impact — skip prevents future selector fits from being poisoned by broken NBM-Prod score. Long-lead dp cells (6-47h) NOT included pending stronger per-regime evidence; selector currently picks NBM there based on l3_nbm helping.
